title: Burned through a $100 subscription building a game with Astra like a Minecraft
author: Wide-Island-5744
selftext:
I built a browser game with Astra and burned through my $100 subscription allowance plus one limit reset getting it together. But what a result! 

I published it to Playgama through MCP – it brought in a couple hundred players for free, and I got my first analytics (like a way to do a quick, small soft launch and find problems). There were a lot of reconnects, long loading times, and players dropping off. But it has an average time spend more then 20 min already

Here’s the game if you want to take a look:  
[https://playgama.ai/play/sywy5buwjv](https://playgama.ai/play/sywy5buwjv)

Did anyone know where I can find right assets with MIT license?
